items.heading: Register As a Student Member
items.text: Register as a student member. Once ACET is cleared, you register with IAI and start clearing the CT/CA/ST-style exam stages while working, usually as an actuarial trainee.

items.heading: Work While You Clear Papers
items.text: Work while you clear papers. Almost nobody becomes a Fellow full-time in a classroom. You work at an insurer, reinsurer, or consulting firm and clear papers over several years alongside the job.

items.heading: Reach Fellowship
items.text: Reach Fellowship. Full qualification typically takes 5 to 8 years of combined study and work. The shortage means firms actively support trainees through this, unlike many other exam-heavy fields.
